Dispatcher: Short note about handover calls at dusk. The Companion Animal Travel Desk must keep every transfer clear and calm.
Coordinator: Crew reports remain steady, but the cabin team needs direct notice when an animal shows distress.
Planner: <<FACT F011>>
Handler: I have checked crate seals, water cups, and calm spacing for the next intake.
Coordinator: Aurelia Skyways expects precise records, and the desk must log every change without delay.
Trainer: The relief route at Vellmar is to be kept clear for traveling pets and their handlers.
Dispatcher: <<FACT F014>>
Planner: Sana Sato and Aya Nakamura should receive quiet support on arrival if their pet needs rest.
Handler: Ginger must be observed for appetite, posture, and any sign of fatigue during transfer.
Coordinator: Send no casual shorthand in the notes, and keep each entry formal for the handover file.
Dispatcher: The cabin team will watch the animals closely and escalate any concern at once.
Trainer: Maintain calm voices, clean hands, and firm but gentle handling throughout the movement.
Planner: The desk will preserve dependable companion travel and document each issue with care.
